## 📝 Description

Please include a summary of the change, which issue is fixed, and relevant motivation and context.

Fixes #(issue)

## 🛠️ Type of Change

- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] ✨ New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] ⚡ Performance improvement
- [ ] 📝 Documentation update
- [ ] 🧪 Tests / CI update
- [ ] 💥 Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)

## 🧪 Testing Checklist

- [ ] All tests pass locally (`swift run ZedFlowTests`)
- [ ] New unit/integration tests added where applicable
- [ ] Tested manually on macOS menu bar UI
- [ ] Tested CLI commands (`zedflow <command>`) where applicable
- [ ] Verified non-blocking streaming and process cleanup behavior
